title: Fee refund policy

display_messages.content:
**Fee Refund Policy – Quick Overview**

| Situation | What Happens | How Much Is Refunded | When You’ll Get It |
|-----------|--------------|----------------------|--------------------|
| **Security Deposit (₹5,000)** | Refund is given **after you finish the programme** or **when you withdraw** (with a No‑Dues Certificate). | Full ₹5,000 **minus** any fine for property damage or disciplinary violations. | Processed after clearance; timing follows the same 45‑60‑day window as other refunds. |
| **Withdrawal **before** classes start** | You can request a tuition‑fee refund. | Refund is **processed as per University & State Level Fee Committee guidelines** (usually the amount you paid, subject to any applicable deductions). | 45‑60 working days from the date your complete refund application is received. |
| **Withdrawal **after** classes have begun** | No tuition‑fee refund is allowed, even if the seat stays vacant. | **None** (only the security‑deposit refund, if you meet the clearance criteria). | Security‑deposit follows the normal 45‑60‑day processing time. |
| **Cancellation by the Institute (disciplinary grounds)** | The Director decides the refund amount. | At the Institute’s discretion; the security deposit may be **partially or fully forfeited** depending on the violation. | Determined by the Director; any approved amount follows the standard processing period. |

### How to Apply for a Refund
1. **Submit a complete refund application** (including the No‑Dues Certificate, if required).  
2. Ensure the application is **signed and dated** and includes your **bank details** for the credit.  
3. Hand it over to the Institute’s Accounts/Administration office.

### Processing Time
- **45 – 60 working days** from the date the **complete** application is received.  
- Keep the **DD receipt** and a copy of your application as proof while you wait.

### Important Tips
- **Pay fees on time** to avoid late‑payment penalties (₹500‑₹2,000 per day, depending on delay).  
- **Clear all dues** (library, hostel, lab, etc.) before requesting a refund; otherwise the No‑Dues Certificate will not be issued.  
- If you’re withdrawing **before classes start**, act quickly—submit the application as soon as you decide to leave, so the 45‑60‑day clock starts earlier.  

Feel free to reach out to the Institute’s Accounts Office if you need any help with the forms or have questions about specific deductions. Good luck!
